# tmux-persist

Keep tmux sessions across reboots on any Linux machine. Saves every session/window/pane layout (cwd + foreground command) every 5 min and at stop, and rebuilds them at boot via systemd user units. Use when asked to set up tmux persistence on a new server, check or repair it, add a program to the re-run allowlist, or recover tmux sessions after a reboot.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 1.0.3
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r tmux-persist ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r tmux-persist .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `scripts/tmux-session.sh`
